add_hint: Single mode: `"hint created: <id>"`. Batch mode: `{ids: [...], errors: {...}}`.
add_intent: Batch mode: `{ids: [...], errors?, skipped?: [{index, summary, existing_id, existing_state}], open_intents?: [{id, summary, priority}], note?}`; `ids` holds 0 for an intent skipped as a duplicate of an open or running one. Single mode: `"intent created: <id>"`, or the batch shape when the intent was skipped or other unclaimed open intents exist.
cancel_intent: `"intent <id> cancelled"`. Errors with the holder label and expiry if another session has a live claim on a running intent.
complete_intent: `"intent <id> marked done"`. Errors with the holder label and expiry if another session has a live claim on a running intent.
engagement_status: `{task_id, exploration_id, goal, status, findings_total, facts_total, frontier_open, done_intents, coverage?}`.
enrich_domain: Discovered DNS records, reverse-DNS results, and any new assets (IPs, subdomains from CNAMEs).
enrich_service: Status code, redirect chain, server headers, page title, TLS certificate details, and detected technologies.
export_engagement: JSON: full engagement export object. CSV: `{format, exported_at, assets_csv, findings_csv, nodes_csv}`.
graph_overview: JSON object with goals, intents (by state), recent facts, findings, credentials, coverage stats, strategic hints, and `changes_cursor` to pass to `list_changes`. Running intents carry `claimed_by` (a holder label) and `claim_expires_at`; open intents whose claim lapsed carry `claim_expired` and `previous_owner`.
list_changes: `{session, cursor, count, truncated, note?, my_claims: [{node_id, claim_expires_at, expired?, payload}], findings?, facts?, intents?, goals?, hints?, assets?}`. `session` is your own holder label, the value other agents see in `claimed_by`. Each change carries `change` (`new` or `updated`) and `changed_at`; running intents carry `claimed_by` (a holder label) and `claim_expires_at`, or `claim_expired`. Without an identity, an MCP session or `owner`, `session` and `my_claims` are replaced by `claims_error`.
list_coverage_gaps: JSON object with gap categories and their entries.
list_engagements: Array of engagement summaries, each with `id`, `goal`, `description`, `status`, `exploration_id`, `created_at`, `node_count`, `finding_count`, `asset_count`, `goals_met`, and `active` flag.
list_evidence: `{count, evidence: [{id, finding_id, kind, filename, size, sha256, created_at}, ...]}`.
list_sessions: `{count, sessions: [{label, self, created_at, last_active, context}, ...], identities: [{name, self, last_active}, ...]}`. `label` is the hashed holder label the session's claims show in `claimed_by` when taken without `owner` (raw session IDs are never returned); `self` marks the caller's own session. `identities` lists the `X-Artex-Identity` names that made requests to this server process within the claim lease; clients on protocol 2026-07-28 have no session and appear only there.
node_detail: Full node object with kind, state, payload, priority, origin, timestamps, and edges.
prove_goal: `"goal <id> marked met"` (or `"goal <id> marked met; all goals of this task are met"`).
record_fact: Single fact: `"fact created: <id>"`. Multiple facts: `{ids: [...], errors: {...}}`.
report_finding: `{finding_id, node_id, possible_duplicates?: [{id, vulnclass, severity, summary}], duplicate_note?}`. `possible_duplicates` lists open findings in this engagement with the same vulnclass (ignoring case, punctuation and common long forms such as "Insecure Direct Object Reference" for `idor`) on an overlapping asset or where either names no asset, or with the same severity on an overlapping asset; merge any that are the same issue with `merge_findings`. Pass `node_id` as `evidence_id` to `prove_goal`.
set_constraints: Single mode: `"constraint created: <id>"`. Batch mode: `{ids: [...], errors: {...}}`.
set_goals: `{created: [{id, text, state}], skipped?: [{text, reason, existing_id?}], existing_goals?: [{id, text, state}], note?, errors?}`. `reason` is `duplicate` (same text as `existing_id`, ignoring case and whitespace) or `goals_already_set`: the engagement already had goals and `append` was not true, so nothing was added and `existing_goals` lists them.
start_intent: `"intent <id> is now running; claimed by <label> until <time>"` (`renewed` when the caller already held the claim). `<label>` is the caller's identity name (with a hashed suffix when `owner` is passed) or otherwise a hash of the holder, never its session ID or `owner`. Errors with the holder label and expiry if another holder has a live claim, or asks for `owner` when the connection has neither an identity nor an MCP session.
traffic_get: Text with `--- REQUEST ---` and `--- RESPONSE ---` sections.
traffic_messages: `{total, messages: [{seq, direction, type, size, payload, event?, blob?, truncated?}, ...]}`.
traffic_patterns: `{top_paths: [{path, count}], error_hosts: [{host, total, codes_4xx, codes_5xx, status_samples}], new_endpoints: [{host, path, first_ts, count}]}`.
